svg.title: How Vocello performs
svg.desc: Vocello 3.1 on a Mac mini M6, 16 GB: about 19 s to make one minute of speech, 0.2–0.4 s until the first audio is ready, and 2.5–4.3 GB of peak memory while it speaks.
